lines.beaver_en: Do you talk to Minsu these days? You two were close.
lines.learner: 아니, 요즘은 거의 안 해. 사이가 많이 멀어졌어.
lines.en: No, hardly at all. We've drifted apart a lot.
lines.roman: ani, yojeumeun geoui an hae. saiga mani meoreojyeosseo.

lines.learner: 누가 헛소문을 퍼뜨린 탓에 서로 불신이 생겼어.
lines.en: Someone spread a false rumor, so we started distrusting each other.
lines.roman: nuga heotsomuneul peotteurin tase seoro bulsini saenggyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: A false rumor? That's shocking. What was it?
lines.learner: 내가 민수 험담을 했다는 거야. 사실이 아닌데.
lines.en: That I talked badly about Minsu. It isn't true.
lines.roman: naega minsu heomdameul haetdaneun geoya. sasiri aninde.

lines.beaver_en: Did you meet him and talk in person?
lines.learner: 응, 그런데 이미 친밀감이 사라진 뒤였어.
lines.en: Yes, but the closeness was already gone.
lines.roman: eung, geureonde imi chinmilgami sarajin dwiyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: That must be a shame. How about our alumni friends?
lines.learner: 동문 모임도 탈퇴했어. 다들 민수 편이라서.
lines.en: I quit the alumni group too. Everyone's on Minsu's side.
lines.roman: dongmun moimdo taltoehaesseo. dadeul minsu pyeoniraseo.

lines.en: Yes, it was a good group where we helped each other. I miss it.

lines.beaver: 또래 친구들 중엔 누가 제일 친해?
lines.beaver_en: Who are you closest to among friends your age?
lines.beaver_roman: ttorae chingudeul jungen nuga jeil chinhae?
lines.learner: 또래보다 회사 동료가 더 친근하게 느껴져.
lines.en: My coworkers feel closer to me than my peers.
lines.roman: ttoraeboda hoesa dongnyoga deo chingeunhage neukkyeojyeo.

lines.beaver: 사교 모임에 새로 나가 보는 건 어때?
lines.beaver_en: How about joining a new social group?
lines.beaver_roman: sagyo moime saero naga boneun geon eottae?
lines.learner: 사람 사귀는 데 자신이 없어서 망설여져.
lines.en: I hesitate because I'm not confident making friends.
lines.roman: saram sagwineun de jasini eopseoseo mangseoryeojyeo.

lines.beaver: 넌 친구 사이가 어떻게 생긴다고 생각해?
lines.beaver_en: How do you think friendships form?
lines.beaver_roman: neon chingu saiga eotteoke saenggindago saenggakae?
lines.learner: 친근감은 시간이 쌓여야 생기는 것 같아.
lines.en: I think familiarity only comes with time.
lines.roman: chingeungameun sigani ssayeoya saenggineun geot gata.

lines.beaver: 맞아. 천천히 다시 시작해 봐. 내가 응원할게.
lines.beaver_en: Right. Start again slowly. I'm rooting for you.
lines.beaver_roman: maja. cheoncheonhi dasi sijakae bwa. naega eungwonhalge.
lines.learner: 고마워. 너랑 얘기하니까 마음이 좀 편해졌어.
lines.en: Thanks. Talking with you makes me feel better.
lines.roman: gomawo. neorang yaegihanikka maeumi jom pyeonhaejyeosseo.
